name: opencode-exoscale
description: OpenCode plugin: Exoscale inference provider. Registers one /connect row per zone (on-demand API key, or EXOSCALE_AI_API_KEY when EXOSCALE_AI_ENDPOINT names the zone) and one row per Dedicated Inference deployment, and discovers models live from each endpoint's /v1/models — no provider or model config in opencode.json.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --strict --allowImportingTsExtensions --target es2022 --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --skipLibCheck --types node index.ts test/index.test.ts
